description: What each kind of page must hold, so pages of one kind have the same structure whichever agent wrote them. required: problems that fail render_page.py --check; recommended: warnings.

rules.blocks_all: every block type listed appears in some section
rules.blocks_any: at least one of the block types listed appears
rules.facts: facts holds each key listed (an empty list is allowed)
rules.facts_nonempty: facts holds each key listed with at least one item

decision.summary: Rules options out and names what is chosen, with what it rests on.

map.summary: Draws what exists and how it connects, so a reader can find their way.

review.summary: Holds something against rules and lists what is wrong, worst first, each with a fix.

incident.summary: One timeline of what happened, the cause and what to do now.

chain.summary: A workflow's closing page: each step, its verdict and whether the chain is done.

report.summary: A result explained in tables, numbers and text, without a choice, a drawing, findings or a timeline at its centre.
